data.exact_reserve_text: In 2015, there has been an overall surplus of GBP 4.8m (2014 deficit of GBP 1m). The surplus is primarily driven by reserve releases on the 2013 and prior year of account due to better than expected claims experience in the marine and energy classes of business.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate recorded a small prior-year favourable development in 2015 amounting to a release of approximately GBP 2.28m (c. -3.18% of opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 71.636m). This release is attributed primarily to better-than-expected claims experience in the Marine and Energy classes, driven by reserve releases on the 2013 and prior years of account. The figure was derived from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) in the Technical Provisions note.
raw_causal_phrases: The surplus is primarily driven by reserve releases on the 2013 and prior year of account due to better than expected claims experience in the marine and energy classes of business.
data.data_quality_notes: Prior year development (PYD) was not provided explicitly as a single gross figure in the movement notes; PYD has been calculated from the gross claims development table (claims triangle) on page 33 by excluding the two most recent underwriting years (2014, 2015) per the rules. Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Technical Provisions 'Balance at 1 January' (page 22). Some named catastrophe items are described generically (no calendar year provided) so event_year is null. LOB-specific PYD amounts are not quantified in the report; LOB movements are inferred from narrative and given low confidence.
